content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 1914389) to the molecule given. The molecule is from previous input? The task: "apply the template as the result of the task make_5_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule below". The molecule is likely the same as in make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 input: there were three SMILES strings (maybe three stereoisomers) as possible products? Actually that input gave list of lists each containing a single SMILES (the product). Those are likely the target molecule(s). So we need to apply the template to each of those molecules and return all possible precursors combinations.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id. Let's apply to each SMILES.

First extract the SMILES strings from that answer. The answer is a JSON-like list of lists: 
[
 ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"],
 ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"],
 ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"]
]

So three target molecules.

We need to apply template 1914389 to each. Use apply_template tool.
